column3: “You became like” is rendered “You compared yourself,” and “sea monster” as “monster.”
“Your height” is rendered “your refuse”; the word is uncertain.
“Bring it down, her and the daughters” follows a difficult Hebrew; “earth of the lower parts” is rendered “nether world.”
“More than whom are you lovely” is rendered “Whom do you surpass in beauty,” and “be laid” as “make your bed.”
“A sword it has been appointed” is rendered “She is given over to the sword.”
“Not they lie” follows the Hebrew; the LXX omits “not.” “From uncircumcised” is rendered “of the uncircumcised.”
“In their strength” is rendered “for all their might.”
“In their terror from their might” is rendered “in spite of the terror resulting from their might.”
